siteName: DeployMate — Autonomous AI Telephony & Workflow Automation

knowledgeBase.question: What does DeployMate build?
knowledgeBase.answer: DeployMate builds bespoke AI voice calling agents, official WhatsApp CRM automation, WebOrient voice co-browsing widgets, and custom AI software systems that automate lead follow-ups, customer support, and appointment booking while cutting operational costs by up to 70%.

knowledgeBase.question: How do DeployMate Voice AI Calling Agents work?
knowledgeBase.answer: Our Voice AI Agents call new leads within 30 seconds of inquiry or answer inbound calls 24/7. They speak natural English, Hindi, and Hinglish, qualify budget and requirements, schedule callback appointments, and sync call summaries straight to your CRM.

knowledgeBase.question: Does DeployMate provide official WhatsApp CRM automation?
knowledgeBase.answer: Yes, DeployMate builds verified WhatsApp Business API bots that automatically dispatch brochures, catalogs, fee structures, and booking links on autopilot 24/7.

knowledgeBase.question: How much can DeployMate save my business?
knowledgeBase.answer: On average, DeployMate reduces operational and telecalling costs by up to 70% while lifting lead-to-booking conversion by +42.8% with sub-4-second lead response times.

knowledgeBase.question: What shipped products has DeployMate built?
knowledgeBase.answer: DeployMate's shipped product suite includes WebOrient (Shadow DOM Voice Co-Pilot & Ghost Cursor), AgentLine (AI Voice Agents on Phone Lines), Sanyy, Inito, BackInsta, Nukky, NukkadMart, Padh.ai, Knot, and Forexyy.

knowledgeBase.question: What is on the /contact ('Start a project') page?
knowledgeBase.answer: The /contact page launches an interactive conversational intake with M.A.T.E. (My Autonomous Technical Expert). It opens with an 'Incoming transmission: M.A.T.E. is better with the sound on' prompt featuring 'Sound on' and 'Keep it silent' buttons, plus top-bar 'Sound on/off' and 'Close X' buttons, followed by step-by-step project brief questions.
